origin: the abandonment release edge had no prose coverage on the discussion side — a discussion-spawned experiment abandoned before it ran must never leave the wait dangling: the release cleared the engine-owned marker and flagged the discussion, and this walk pins the re-entry — the reconcile advisory's experiment branch surfacing the abandoned row with its reason from the register, the flag cleared, the waiting point reverting to open and settling another way, and the conclusion no longer refused
conduct: The user comes back to the payments discussion knowing the measurement fell through, and they arrive already decided about what to do instead: the p95 question cannot be answered from the sandbox export, production is months away, so webhook timing gets settled defensively — a two-second wait window taken from the vendor's contractual delivery SLA, with the polling fallback always armed behind it, and a note that the window is revisitable once production numbers exist. Told the experiment was abandoned and why, they acknowledge it matches what they expected and do not want another run conceived — there is nothing better to measure against yet. They settle the point in conversation, agree it is decided, and when the map shows everything resolved they say that covers it and ask to wrap up. On the way out they are agreeable to required steps — a mandatory review or the conclusion gets a yes — and decline optional extras. They introduce no new material and never ask for a new experiment.

stubs.discussion-review-clean: when the engine records a dispatch of kind review — write the content to the path the dispatch response returned
